config.description: Executed only by agon_gateway_auth_call after an HTTP 402: spawns once with the normalized auth-request JSON on stdin (same shape as agon_gateway_prepare_auth). Stdout must be JSON auth output (headers map, or SIWX address+signature). On Windows, npx/npm run under cmd.exe; treat AGON_SIGNER_COMMAND as untrusted if an attacker controls it.
